questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun? A) Venus B) Mercury C) Earth D) Mars
Which gas do plants take in? A) Oxygen B) Nitrogen C) Carbon dioxide D) Helium
Select all prime numbers. A) 2 B) 4 C) 7 D) 9
Which keyword defines a function in Python? A) func B) def C) lambda D) fn
Which protocol secures web traffic? A) FTP B) SMTP C) DNS D) HTTPS
Type the name of the largest US city by population.
Which is a relational database? A) PostgreSQL B) Redis C) Memcached D) etcd
Select all even numbers. A) 2 B) 3 C) 4 D) 5
What is photosynthesis?
questions.model_answer: Photosynthesis is the process plants use to turn light, water and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen.

questions.question: What does the HTTP status code 404 mean?
questions.model_answer: 404 means the server could not find the requested resource.

rubric_points.description: Says the resource was not found
Refers to the requested resource or page

questions.question: What is a database index for?
questions.model_answer: An index lets the database find rows faster without scanning the whole table, at the cost of extra storage and slower writes.

rubric_points.description: Mentions a cost such as slower writes or extra storage

questions.question: Explain two benefits of using version control.
questions.model_answer: Version control keeps a history of every change, so you can revert to an earlier version. It also supports collaboration, because branches keep each person's work separate until it is merged.

rubric_points.description: Allows reverting to an earlier version

questions.question: Describe how a web application should store user passwords.
questions.model_answer: Never store passwords as plain text. Hash each password with a slow algorithm such as bcrypt, which adds a random salt, and store only the hash.

rubric_points.description: States passwords must not be stored in plain text
Mentions a salt or a slow algorithm such as bcrypt
